skill.name: giil
skill.description: Download full-resolution images from public iCloud, Dropbox, Google Photos, and Google Drive share links for remote AI workflows.
skill.summary: Download public cloud-share images into terminal workflows for AI-assisted debugging.
skill.author: Dicklesworthstone

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown code fences, inline code, and documented CLI examples. Confirmed findings are the community install instructions that fetch mutable GitHub content and execute or install it locally, which creates supply-chain risk. No prompt injection attempt was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.issue: Remote installer is piped directly into bash.
remediation.suggestion: Replace curl pipe-to-shell examples with release downloads, checksum verification, and explicit script review before execution.

remediation.issue: Manual install downloads executable code from a branch URL.
remediation.suggestion: Pin downloads to immutable release artifacts or commit URLs and publish checksums or signatures.

remediation.issue: Uninstall instructions use recursive deletion in cache directories.
remediation.suggestion: Provide a dedicated uninstall command that deletes only files created by giil and warns before removing shared Playwright caches.

static_findings.snippet: **Note:** First run downloads Playwright Chromium (~200MB, cached in `~/.cache/giil/`).
**Google Photos Full-Res:** Automatically appends `=s0` to CDN URLs for maximum resolution.
- Monitors all HTTP responses for CDN patterns (`cvws.icloud-content.com`, etc.)
| `--preserve` | off | Keep original bytes (skip MozJPEG compression) |
| `--base64` | off | Output base64 to stdout (no file saved) |
| `--all` | off | Download all photos from album |
| `--timeout N` | `60` | Page load timeout in seconds |
| `--debug` | off | Save debug artifacts on failure |
| `--trace` | off | Enable Playwright tracing for deep debugging |
| `--print-url` | off | Output resolved CDN URL (don't download) |
Validates HTTP `Content-Type` matches expected image types.
| `1` | Capture Failure | All capture strategies failed |
| `2` | Usage Error | Invalid arguments or missing URL |
| `3` | Dependency Error | Node.js, Playwright, or Chromium issue |
| `10` | Network Error | Timeout, DNS failure, unreachable host |
| `11` | Auth Required | Login redirect, password required, not publicly shared |
| `12` | Not Found | Expired link, deleted file, 404 |
| `13` | Unsupported Type | Video, Google Doc, or non-image content |
| `20` | Internal Error | Bug in giil (please report!) |
Run with `--debug` to see page state. Report issue with debug artifacts.

content.user_title: Download Cloud Images for Remote AI Debugging
content.value_statement: Moving screenshots from mobile cloud shares into remote AI sessions is slow and error prone. GIIL downloads public cloud images into terminal workflows for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
actual_capabilities: Downloads images from public iCloud, Dropbox, Google Photos, and Google Drive share links.
Uses Playwright browser automation when pages require JavaScript rendering.
Captures images through download buttons, network interception, image elements, or viewport screenshots.
Supports album downloads with indexed output names and retry behavior.
Outputs file paths, JSON metadata, direct CDN URLs, or base64 data.
Handles HEIC and HEIF conversion through platform tools when available.
limitations: Requires public share links; private or login-protected content fails.
First browser-based runs may download Chromium and take longer.
Some HEIC conversion paths need local operating-system packages.
Remote installation commands should be reviewed before use.

use_cases.title: Debug mobile screenshots over SSH
use_cases.description: Download an iPhone screenshot from a public cloud link into a remote terminal for AI-assisted UI debugging.

use_cases.title: Collect support images quickly
use_cases.description: Pull customer-provided public image links into a support workspace without manual browser downloads.

use_cases.title: Prepare visual review assets
use_cases.description: Capture original-resolution images from public cloud shares for documentation, QA, or design review.

prompt_templates.title: Download one image
prompt_templates.prompt: Use giil to download this public image link: <url>. Return the local path and basic dimensions.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare AI screenshot review
prompt_templates.prompt: Download this iCloud screenshot with JSON output, then summarize the path, size, and capture method for Claude Code.

prompt_templates.title: Collect a shared album
prompt_templates.prompt: Download all images from this public album into <directory>. Use indexed filenames and report failed items separately.

prompt_templates.title: Automate a safe workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a safe script that validates a supported share URL, runs giil with JSON output, checks exit codes, and avoids uploading data.

output_examples.input: A public iCloud share link for one iPhone screenshot.
output_examples.output: The skill returns a local image path, resolution details, and the capture method used.

output_examples.input: A Google Photos album link for UI bug screenshots.
output_examples.output: The skill saves numbered files in the chosen folder and reports any photos that failed.

output_examples.input: A Dropbox image link in a remote shell.
output_examples.output: The skill uses the direct download path when possible and prints the saved file location.

best_practices: Review remote install scripts before running them.
Use public links only when you have permission to access and process the images.
Prefer JSON output for automated Claude, Codex, or Claude Code workflows.
anti_patterns: Do not paste private or login-protected links and expect authentication bypass.
Do not pipe downloaded image data to external APIs without user approval.
Do not delete shared Playwright caches unless you know other tools do not need them.

faq.question: Does GIIL need a browser?
faq.answer: Yes for iCloud, Google Photos, and Google Drive flows that require JavaScript. Dropbox links can often use direct download.

faq.question: Can it access private albums?
faq.answer: No. It is designed for public share links and reports authentication errors for private or expired links.

faq.question: Where are downloaded files saved?
faq.answer: Files are saved to the current directory by default, or to the directory selected with the output option.

faq.question: Is it useful with Claude Code or Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. It helps remote agents inspect screenshots and visual assets without manual file transfer.

faq.question: Does it upload images automatically?
faq.answer: No. The documented workflow downloads images locally unless a user builds a separate upload pipeline.

faq.question: Why is installation flagged in the audit?
faq.answer: The docs recommend remote shell installation. Users should inspect installer scripts and prefer pinned releases with checksums.
